name: Roanoke - The Lost Colony
source:
Roanoke - The Lost Colony is a creepy Horror Visual Novel Game  based on the rumours around the real Roanoke Island.

Somehow you ended up getting there.
Even before you realize it, your life is in danger! 
Will you make the right decisions to survive?
Or will you be lost in the forests of Roanoke?
Are these things really happening or are you just going nuts?

[From [url=https://tapmeh.itch.io/roanoke-the-lost-colony] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗阿诺克 - 失落的殖民地是一款令人毛骨悚然的恐怖视觉小说游戏，基于真实的罗阿诺克岛周围的谣言。

不知怎的，你最终到达了那里。
甚至在你意识到之前，你的生命就处于危险之中！
你会做出正确的决定来生存吗？
或者你会迷失在罗阿诺克的森林中吗？
这些事情真的发生了还是你只是疯了？

[来自[url=https://tapmeh.itch.io/roanoke-the-lost-colony] itch.io[/url]]
